findings.text: Definition signals for inn1/any and the bowler side use LOMO par, LOMO exp_remaining and full-sample ranks in existing code; design only makes par strictly prior. Specify prior-only/TRAIN-only signals per candidate and extend LeakageGuard.
Unique exact name matches to ipl squad.csv are labelled VERIFIED_FROM_SOURCE, contradicting 'name matching only generates candidates'. Require team/player_id corroboration (DERIVED) or leave Unknown.
Order of selection steps (definition, shrinkage, eligibility) not fixed; B_i depends on k and definition. State the order.
Definition score Sc under-specified: Spearman-Brown/Fisher-z bounds, weights, one-non-estimable-cell comparability, undefined Gate 2, margin ignores Sc noise.
Tie-break by largest absolute pooled D rewards extreme thresholds mechanically and ignores direction. Pre-declare expected sign or make D report-only.
Eligibility data-weight gate uses median over eligible players, so thin players pass; 'significantly negative' reproducibility undefined; fallback picks a noisy maximum.
Window for eligibility ball counts and for shrinkage mu_{-i} in PRE_TEST scoring is ambiguous; TRAIN-derived thresholds applied to a longer window; possible deviation from 'training only'.
Frozen-choices hash location unspecified, freeze-before-test order not auditable, and LockedFrame is bypassable by direct DuckDB/pandas reads.
Capped status derived from all T20I appearances including TEST period (no as_of_date); 'played' undefined; API profile stats may expose TEST outcomes before the lock opens.
Optimiser score scale, direction (bowler runs conceded), two-sided players and role enumeration undefined.
Format-combined estimate formula/interval, meaningful Top-10 overlap rule and baseline alternatives not specified in these documents.
Shrinkage choice rule uses an undefined bootstrap standard error; specify paired match-cluster SE of loss difference vs shrink_eb.
Rolling-origin folds need per-origin refit of baseline and shrinkage parameters to be out-of-sample.
State whether selection-stability bootstrap recomputes TRAIN quantile thresholds per resample.
